dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: It sounds like the tea here must be quite expensive.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Who said that a teahouse must only sell tea?

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: Someone stupid like you shouldn't be out making a mess of our city. Your time would be better spent listening to an opera or sitting in a restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: There're some places you don't belong, and you're most certainly not needed around here.

dialogues.speaker: Chuyi
dialogues.text: If you don't leave, I will have to ask security to "escort" you away.
